purpose: Teach: かから/そうして/背筋/座ら/変えれ/ぼろ/ふら/きょう

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お店の改装、あまりお金がかからない計画なの
lines.en: Sho, the store renovation is going to be on a pretty tight budget.
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful. Speaking as if working through the plan aloud. Warm but practical. The tone of someone who trusts the listener to understand without needing reassurance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、そうしてメイ姉さんはお店を始めたのね
lines.en: Mei-sis… so that's how you started your store?
lines.style: Quiet curiosity, with genuine interest underneath. Not pressing for an answer. The careful listening of a perceptive child processing something bigger than himself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お背筋を伸ばしてお勉強してね
lines.en: Sho, make sure you keep your back straight when you study, okay?
lines.style: Soft instruction, not stern. The affectionate attentiveness of someone who notices posture because she cares. Light and natural, like a habit of looking after him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、長く座らないでお手伝いしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I helped out without sitting down the whole time.
lines.style: Small, genuine pride in his voice. Not boasting — offering this to her like a gift. A slight brightness at the end, waiting to see if she notices.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ノートを変えればもっとお勉強楽しくなるかも
lines.en: Sho, if you switched notebooks, studying might become more fun.
lines.style: Offering an idea gently, almost to herself. Warm consideration. Not pushing — planting a thought for him to find later. The voice of someone who knows him well enough to suggest without commanding.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくの上靴、もうぼろぼろだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my indoor shoes are falling apart.
lines.style: Wry observation, tinged with small complaint but not serious. The tone of a child pointing out something obvious, trusting her to understand it matters without drama. A touch of humor underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お疲れの時はふらふらせずに座ってね
lines.en: Sho, when you're tired, sit down instead of wobbling around, okay?
lines.style: Gentle concern wrapped in care. Not alarmed — observant and protective. Warm but direct, the way someone speaks when they've noticed something small and want to help before it becomes a problem.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、きょう、ぼくと遊んでくれてありがとう
lines.en: Mei-sis, thank you for playing with me today.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. The words come out slowly, with real feeling behind them. No performance — just gratitude, simple and complete. A small, genuine closing.
